storage.contents: One resumable draft and at most 20 explicitly saved recaps
storage.writeContract: Read-back verified; failed/unavailable storage leaves editable in-memory state and a truthful error
storage.resume: Refresh reopens the saved phase and authored content
storage.delete: Clear Tara data deletes draft and all recaps; existing app-wide deletion covers mentation. and clears mounted Tara state via its event
storage.integrity: Unreadable/future-schema data is preserved until the user chooses deletion
storage.completedRecap: A persisted completionReported flag prevents a normal recap refresh from emitting another completion; saved-recap browsing is review-only. Host session persistence is authoritative if local writes fail.
storage.exportIntegration: Current main exportLocalAppData omits the Tara key. Include validated Tara draft/recaps in explicit data export if the host promises export of saved practices.
storage.savedMemoryIntegration: Current deleteFlagshipMemory(saved/all) uses explicit SHARED_RETURN_KEYS; include mentation.tara-tactician.v1 there, and notify/unmount the active Tara view when deletion is invoked. Full deleteAllLocalAppData already covers the key and emits the observed sessions-changed signal.

visualReference.chosenTreatment: Editorial Garamond headings, Hanken interface text, soft ivory/pale aqua surfaces, deep teal/aqua/pink accents, detailed existing Tara artwork occupying approximately a quarter of the mobile heading area. Dark teal is reserved for Tackle/live support.
visualReference.asset: public/media/brand/tara-tactician.webp already exists in base repository; no image edit or new dependency
